text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
(Chatter chatter chatter chatter 
chatter...!)

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
It's finally here, the day has finally 
arrived! Admire Vega, TM Opera O, Narita 
Top Road, and Meisho Doto!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
The Big Three who hyped up last year's 
Classic season so much, plus Doto reaching 
her full potential... Aah, I'm so glad to 
be alive in this era!

text_block_list.name: Ayabe Fan A
text_block_list.text:
“Still, Admire Vega is taking the Autumn 
Tenno Sho. On top of her usual intensity, 
she's been looking like she actually 
enjoys running since spring... She's 
flawless!”

text_block_list.name: Opera O Fan A
text_block_list.text:
No way, it's gotta be Opera O!! That 
crazy, incomprehensible presence! That 
absurd strength! If we're talking about 
who represents our generation, it's Opera 
O, no doubt!!

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan A
text_block_list.text: ...It's not true. It's not true...!

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan B
text_block_list.text:
This time for sure... Today's the day Top 
Road-san is going to win...!!

Seeing her take a slow, deep breath after 
finishing her preparations right before 
post time, I suddenly felt an urge to ask.

"Come to think of it, this is a question 
I've hardly ever asked before, but—"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: "...Yes. I suppose I am, a little."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I think... I've started thinking about a 
lot of different things.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
In the past, it was, 'Win. Because that is 
my mission.' ...It was simple, and that 
was nice, but.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Right now—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Opera O's bottomless depth. Dotou's 
tenacity.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: And then, Top Road-san's resolve.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's desire to win. ...And my desire 
to win.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
The exhilaration of heading to a race. The 
slight fear of stepping onto the track.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I'm thinking about various things.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: "So, yes. ...I think I'm nervous."

I start to say that it's a good kind of 
nervous tension, but stop myself.

...Because I wanted her to savor how she's 
feeling right now, just a little longer.

text_block_list.name: Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega-san! Please head to the 
paddock!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, I'm off.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —I'll go and win this.
